top_pick.reason: Best first-frame stop and cleanest stageability. The hook is three words, the scene has immediate body proof, and the carousel can stay inside one room without microtext, quote-card drift, or repeated close sideways couple staging.
top_pick.why_it_beats_the_obvious_winner_bank_opt: The DZTTSUBEaRr ordinary-phrases idea is broader and source-stronger, but visually it risks becoming a phrase list. 'Please vent more' gives Tara one frame that already contains the whole send reason.
top_pick.required_repair_before_idea_lock: Coordinator should record the source gap honestly: DZS2GuipLku has public likes/comments but no scraped saves/shares and is not a full winner-bank carousel. Pair it with owned DYJpjt9CQYY send-behavior evidence if selected.

visual_risks.repair: Every slide needs a lived Aachu/Zuv action, not decorative typography over a soft background.
Keep the bedroom frame wide with distance and hands; do not turn it into a forehead-touch close-up.
Do not render chat bubbles. The generated on-image text carries the message.
Door lock, charger, helmet, and plate are receipts only; the premise remains being known or quietly cared for.
Ban 'safe space', 'emotional regulation', 'communication', and 'love language' from slide copy.

tara_01_please_vent_more.why: Needs hook, permission detail, deeper proof, soft turn, and payoff. Fewer slides make it a static quote; more slides over-explain the vent.

tara_02_text_me_when_you_reach.why: Four phrase-scenes are enough. A fifth only works if the doorway payoff is strong.

tara_03_boring_details.why: The list needs enough receipts to feel personal, but no more than one detail per slide.

tara_04_nothing_happened_subtitles.why: The private translation needs a gradual physical softening. Three slides would feel abrupt; more than five risks melodrama.

tara_05_waiting_downstairs.why: Best if compressed: waiting, ride, home receipt, payoff. Five slides risks generic ordinary-love padding.

Strong source and broad sendability; slightly weaker because it can slide into a phrase-list quote card.
Owned-performance engine is strong and copy is sendable; needs careful detail selection to avoid a quirky habit list.
Highest source strength and strong payoff; lower rank only because it risks repeating the existing calm-girl emotional territory.
